title: TesseraQL business-day calendars v1
description: Schema for TesseraQL calendar documents (calendars/*.yml): named business-day calendars referenced from a job schedule's 'calendar:'. Documented in jobs.md (Business-day calendars).

calendars.description: Named calendars: a weekend definition plus holidays.

weekend.description: Weekly non-business days as lowercase day names; omitted means saturday/sunday.

holidays.description: The calendar's holidays: exactly one home for the rows — a fixed dates: list for small closed sets, or a table-backed source: operations maintains as rows, read on the job's datasource at fire time.

calendar.description: The calendar-name column, for a shared table carrying several calendars.
